meta.name: agent-tui
meta.description: Automate terminal UI (TUI) apps with agent-tui for testing, inspection, demos, and scripted interactions. Use when automating CLI/TUI flows, regression testing terminal apps, verifying interactive behavior, or extracting structured text from terminal UIs. Also use when asked what agent-tui is, how it works, or to demo it. Do not use for web browsers, GUI apps, or non-terminal interfaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化终端界面应用的测试与演示
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要自动化测试终端界面应用
copy.tagline_en: Automate terminal UI apps for testing and scripted interactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate testing of terminal UI applications

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能借助 agent-tui 命令操控终端文字界面程序，自动进行测试、检查、演示和脚本化交互，并读取界面上的文字。
howto.when: 当用户要求自动化终端程序、做回归测试、验证交互行为等，或询问 agent-tui 是什么、怎么用时触发。

say.text: 用 agent-tui 驱动这个终端程序，跑一遍注册流程
say.note: 它会启动会话并逐步按键输入

say.text: 给这个命令行应用做一次回归测试，验证界面是否正常
say.note: 它会用 wait 断言检查文字

say.text: 用 agent-tui 截取当前终端界面，看看显示什么
say.note: 它会返回最新界面文字和状态

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use agent-tui commands to control terminal UI (TUI) apps, automating testing, inspection, demos, and scripted interactions, and extracting visible text from the interface.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to automate terminal programs, run regression tests, verify interactive behavior, extract text from TUI, or asks what agent-tui is and how to use it.

say_en.text: Drive this terminal program with agent-tui and run the signup flow.
say_en.note: It starts a session and sends keys.

say_en.text: Run a quick regression test on this CLI app to verify the UI.
say_en.note: It uses wait assertions to check text.

say_en.text: Use agent-tui to screenshot the current terminal screen.
say_en.note: It returns the latest UI text and status.
